desc: Realistic room-preparation scene with a contained tan ceiling water stain, a neatly cut drywall inspection opening, floor protection, and a moisture meter staged below.
reuse_notes: Use for water-damaged ceiling diagnosis, leak-source investigation, drywall repair planning, moisture inspection, and post-leak remediation articles. It conveys a bounded, realistic repair scope rather than an emergency or a completed JK Prestige project; do not use it to diagnose a cause without site inspection.
